roadmap.title: Story and side content
roadmap.description: Play the story on Action difficulty up to the point-of-no-return prompt before the last mission. Rescue citizens, finish Chance Encounters and Mysteries, and let the combat counters build up naturally.

roadmap.title: Cleanup before the final mission
roadmap.description: Free roam stays open until "The Clash At Rendaino". Finish every collectible, upgrade, and leftover combat counter, then make a manual save.

roadmap.title: Finish the first playthrough
roadmap.description: Start the final mission, beat both final bosses, and clear the achievements that pop at the end of the run. This unlocks Carnage difficulty.

roadmap.title: Carnage New Game+
roadmap.description: Replay the story on Carnage difficulty in New Game+. Skills, pouches, charms, items, Genma notes and Lion Dogs carry over.

roadmap.title: Boss Rematch
roadmap.description: Beat every Boss Rematch fight in the Practice Grounds, using Carnage clears to cover the lower difficulties, to finish the list.

achievements.sortReason: Final-mission or last-step unlock.
achievements.summary: Earn every other achievement in the game.

steps.text: Unlock all 51 other achievements; this one pops last.

achievements.sortReason: Story boss in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Defeat Sasaki Ganryu at Kiyomizu-dera Temple at the end of the tutorial.

steps.text: Clear the 2 Thread Genma, then enter @loc{Kiyomizu-dera Temple} and fight @enemy{Sasaki Ganryu}.
Parry his attacks and punish with up to 3 Light Attacks to build an Issen Attack, then use the prompted Issen on the red target.
steps.note: If he stops attacking, his stamina bar refills, so keep up pressure.

achievements.sortReason: Story boss in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Defeat Daidara in the Oni Refuge.

steps.text: Activate the @loc{Shrine Grounds} Spirit Mirror in the @loc{Oni Refuge}, then enter the room with the mission marker.
Parry the cleaver sweeps and the ramming charge. Dodge the kick and the overhead smash. Hit his legs to crack their armor.
Pick up the floating orbs quickly.
steps.note: Orbs he absorbs make him enraged, faster and stronger.

achievements.sortReason: Story boss in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Defeat Rasho-gan after you recover the 3 statues during "Be Careful What You Wish For".

steps.text: Bring the 3 statues back, then fight @enemy{Rasho-gan} in the cutscene that follows.
Stay aggressive in phase 2. His stamina refills fast, and he is already in Blazing State.

achievements.sortReason: Story boss in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Defeat Ifuu as the final fight of the mission "Windswept Kennin-ji".

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Ifuu} at the end of @loc{Windswept Kennin-ji}.
Deflect his breath attacks back at him to drain his stamina.
In phase 2, shoot the air sack behind his head with an arrow when it swells or when he jumps, to stun him.

achievements.sortReason: Story boss in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Greater Nue inside the Kyoto Imperial Palace, in the Oikeniwa Pond Garden.

guide.context: The achievement pops after the cutscene that sends you after Hinagiku.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Oikeniwa Pond Garden} and fight the @enemy{Greater Nue}.
When its stamina breaks, pick the tail as the Issen target. Without its tail it cannot guard or use its unavoidable sweep for a short time.
Use Oni Power to break its tail guard, and parry or dodge the lightning attacks.

achievements.sortReason: Story boss in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Defeat Benkei in the mission "Bloodbath on the Bridge".

steps.text: Enter the bridge and fight @enemy{Benkei}. This is the only objective of the mission.
Damage him only with Issen, Break Issen, and the attacks shown after a timed Reflex Dodge.
Parry his glaive swings and bait attacks with light attacks.
steps.note: His stamina refills fast if you let him idle. Blocking and dodging do not damage it.

achievements.sortReason: Story boss in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Defeat Burai during "A Tempest at the Temple".

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Burai} in the temple where you fought Ifuu.
Move out of the purple beams, and use Focus Evade against the X-pattern orbs and his enraged lightning drop.
Do not hit him while he holds his pose, or he teleports behind you.

achievements.sortReason: Story boss in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Defeat Shuten Doji to finish "The Demon on the Mount".

guide.context: Use as few healing items as you can in phase 1. A cutscene starts phase 2, and if you die after it you restart at phase 2 with the healing items you had left.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Shuten Doji} to finish @loc{The Demon on the Mount}. When he breathes in, shoot him with an arrow to cancel the attack you cannot avoid.
Phase 2 starts after a cutscene in Oni form, with a separate head and body. Use Issen and your Oni Armament to keep the Oni Gauge up.
Shoot the head with an arrow when it swells to stop its fire breath.

achievements.sortReason: Story boss in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Defeat Ifuu and Burai together in the mission "Storm Chaser".

steps.text: Fight both bosses in @loc{Storm Chaser}. Each has 2 health bars to drain, in any order.
Stay defensive and punish only after their combos. Deflect their joint attacks for large stamina damage.
Shoot Ifuu out of the air when Burai circles himself with orbs, but not while you stand in the orb path.

achievements.sortReason: Story boss in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Defeat the second Sasaki Ganryu fight, in the Arashiyama field beside the Togetsu-kyo Bridge Spirit Mirror.

steps.text: Find @enemy{Sasaki Ganryu} in the field beside the @loc{Togetsu-kyo Bridge} Spirit Mirror.
Play defensively. His swords can be parried, blocked, or countered with Issen.
Use Oni Power early so you can use it a second time later in the fight.

achievements.sortReason: Story boss in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Defeat Dokyo at the end of Arashiyama.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Dokyo} at the end of @loc{Arashiyama}. Dodge the orbs, laser bars, and spikes, then attack in the gaps.
Shoot the growing mask with an arrow while it circles Dokyo.
When Dokyo splits in two, use Oni Vision and shoot the clone with the gold aura.
In phase 2, stand behind the rock when the giant sphere charges.

achievements.sortReason: Final-mission or last-step unlock.
achievements.summary: Defeat Benkei in the mission "The Clash at Rendaino".

guide.context: Free roam ends when this mission starts, so finish side content first.

steps.text: Accept @loc{The Clash at Rendaino}. The fight starts at once.
In phase 2, land the odd arrow headshot so his stamina stays down. Spend your Oni gauge early so it refills for a second use.

achievements.sortReason: Final-mission or last-step unlock.
achievements.summary: Defeat Minamoto no Yoshitsune in the last boss fight.

guide.context: Save your consumables for the second half of phase 2 and for phase 3.

steps.text: Before the fight, carry up to 2 each of Amulet of Introspection, Stimulant, Greater Defense Talisman, Greater Might Talisman and Heavy Restoratives, plus 1 Sun-Dried Hozuki.
Phase 1: deflect or parry his katana attacks. Parry the dash-slash right after his shoulder tap.
Phase 2: run away from the slam and ground crack, and lean on deflects. Choose purple souls when his stamina breaks.
Phase 3: he is only damaged while you are in Oni Awakening. Fill the gauge with Issen counters or parries, transform, and counter.
Use your finisher when the Awakening gauge is almost empty.
steps.note: Dodge or Issen the arena-wide slash after he absorbs all souls.

achievements.description: Complete your first Mystery of Kyoto.
achievements.sortReason: Side activity found during the campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete your first Mystery of Kyoto.

steps.text: Finish any one of the 8 @mechanic{Mysteries of Kyoto}.

achievements.sortReason: Collection cleanup before the final mission.
achievements.summary: Complete all 8 Mysteries of Kyoto.

guide.context: Mysteries do not carry into New Game+, so finish them in one playthrough.

steps.text: Finish all 8 @mechanic{Mysteries of Kyoto} before the final mission.

achievements.sortReason: Side activity found during the campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete your first Chance Encounter.

steps.text: Finish any one of the 18 @mechanic{Chance Encounters}.

achievements.sortReason: Collection cleanup before the final mission.
achievements.summary: Complete all 18 Chance Encounters.

guide.context: Chance Encounters do not carry into New Game+, so finish them in one playthrough.

steps.text: Finish all 18 @mechanic{Chance Encounters} before the final mission.

achievements.description: Defeat the Byakue at Kiyomizu-dera Temple.
achievements.sortReason: Side activity found during the campaign.
achievements.summary: Kill the Byakue guarding the Kiyomizu-dera Temple area.

guide.context: This Byakue stands by a Kubi Akari target used in the "Ace Archer" Chance Encounter at that temple.

steps.text: In @loc{Kiyomizu-dera Temple}, head north from the @loc{Nio-mon Gate} Spirit Mirror to the Oni Wall and go through.
Defeat the @enemy{Byakue}. It has one health bar and falls to 2 Issen Breaks.

achievements.sortReason: Side activity found during the campaign.
achievements.summary: Rescue 30 townspeople from attacking Genma.

guide.context: A rescue only counts after you speak to the citizen.

steps.text: Beat the Genma attacking any citizen you find in Kyoto, then speak to the citizen. Repeat until you have rescued 30.

achievements.description: Rescue a merchant that's being attacked by Genma.
achievements.sortReason: Side activity found during the campaign.
achievements.summary: Rescue a merchant who is being attacked by Genma.

guide.context: Merchant attacks are random, but one usually appears before the 30th rescue.

steps.text: Keep rescuing citizens until a merchant is attacked, beat the Genma, and speak to the merchant.

achievements.sortReason: Side activity found during the campaign.
achievements.summary: Rescue your first Lion Dog.

steps.text: Find and rescue any one of the 36 @mechanic{Lion Dogs}.

achievements.sortReason: Collection cleanup before the final mission.
achievements.summary: Rescue all 36 Lion Dogs.

guide.context: Rescued Lion Dogs carry into New Game+.

steps.text: Rescue all 36 @mechanic{Lion Dogs}.

achievements.sortReason: Collection cleanup before the final mission.
achievements.summary: Collect all 23 Genma Notes.

guide.context: Genma Notes carry into New Game+. The achievement may pop only when you finish the final mission.

steps.text: Collect all 23 Genma Notes. Re-read the collected ones in the menu to see which you still need.

achievements.description: Complete the game on difficulty level Carnage.
achievements.sortReason: Needs the Carnage New Game+ run.
achievements.summary: Complete the game on Carnage difficulty.

steps.text: Finish the story once on any difficulty to unlock Carnage.
Begin New Game+ on Carnage and play through to the end.
Save Revival Mirrors and healing items in your first run.
steps.note: Items carry into New Game+. Carnage has no action prompts.

achievements.description: Beat an opponent in a Boss Rematch.
achievements.sortReason: Boss Rematch mode.
achievements.summary: Beat any opponent in Boss Rematch.

guide.context: The Practice Grounds unlock during the mission "The Oni's Apprentice".

steps.text: In @loc{Emma's Hall}, ring the bell in the corner to enter the Practice Grounds.
Speak to Takamura, choose @mechanic{Boss Rematch}, and win against any boss.

achievements.description: Beat all Boss Rematch opponents on all difficulty levels.
achievements.sortReason: Boss Rematch mode.
achievements.summary: Beat every Boss Rematch opponent on every difficulty level.

guide.context: You can use almost no items in the rematches except your pouch.

steps.text: Use @loc{Emma's Hall} and Takamura to start each @mechanic{Boss Rematch} fight.
Beat every available boss on Carnage. A Carnage win also counts for the lower difficulties.
Clear Carnage in the story first.
steps.note: It grants a weapon that makes the rematches much easier.

achievements.displayName: The Winding Way of the Sword
achievements.description: Learn and upgrade all basic or special skills.
achievements.sortReason: Upgrade milestone.
achievements.summary: Learn and upgrade all basic skills or all special skills.

guide.context: Skills cost Power Stones, Oni Stones, and Red Souls. The achievement may pop only when you finish the final mission.

steps.text: Open a Spirit Mirror, choose Enhance Equipment/Abilities, and buy and upgrade every skill in either the basic tab or the special tab.

achievements.description: Learn and upgrade all basic and special skills.
achievements.sortReason: Upgrade milestone.
achievements.summary: Learn and upgrade all basic skills and all special skills.

guide.context: Unlock the three Oni Vision skills (Treasures, Treasures 2, Search Range) early to spot stones faster.

steps.text: At a Spirit Mirror, choose Enhance Equipment/Abilities and buy every skill in both tabs.
Collect all 54 Power Stones and 55 Oni Stones for the upgrades, and buy the rest from Yorimasa's Monument.
Get the Flashing Void spear on Mount Oe beyond the castle elevator, and the Still Water sword after the Swamp 1 checkpoint in Arima.
steps.note: Their skills only unlock once you own the weapon.

achievements.description: Enhance a piece of equipment for the first time.
achievements.sortReason: Upgrade milestone.
achievements.summary: Upgrade any one piece of gear for the first time.

guide.context: The Spirit Mirror enhancement menu unlocks in the mission "The Oni's Apprentice".

steps.text: At a Spirit Mirror, open the Equipment Enhancement tab and upgrade any item once.

achievements.description: Enhance all equipment to the maximum level.
achievements.sortReason: Upgrade milestone.
achievements.summary: Enhance all equipment to its maximum level.

guide.context: Sword and gauntlet upgrades do not carry into New Game+, so max them in one run. The last gauntlet levels need Byakue's Talisman and Dohatsu-ten's Horn, which the final-mission bosses and respawning spots in eastern Kyoto can give.

steps.text: At a Spirit Mirror, use the Equipment Enhancement tab to raise your clothing, sword and gauntlet to their maximum levels.
Gather 25 Fine Silk Cloths and 25 Tamahagane, plus the common materials. Buy extra at Yorimasa's Monument.

achievements.sortReason: Collection cleanup before the final mission.
achievements.summary: Acquire all 7 Oni Armaments.

steps.text: Find and collect all 7 Oni Armaments.

achievements.description: Enhance a Hozuki Pouch to the maximum level.
achievements.sortReason: Collection cleanup before the final mission.
achievements.summary: Enhance a Hozuki Pouch to its maximum level.

steps.text: Fully upgrade any one Hozuki Pouch.

achievements.description: Enhance all Hozuki Pouches to the maximum level.
achievements.sortReason: Collection cleanup before the final mission.
achievements.summary: Enhance all 9 Hozuki Pouches to their maximum level.

guide.context: Pouches and their upgrades carry into New Game+.

steps.text: Find all 9 Hozuki Pouches and fully upgrade each one.

achievements.description: Enhance a charm to the maximum level.
achievements.sortReason: Collection cleanup before the final mission.
achievements.summary: Enhance a charm to its maximum level.

steps.text: Fully upgrade any one charm.

achievements.description: Enhance all charms to the maximum level.
achievements.sortReason: Collection cleanup before the final mission.
achievements.summary: Enhance all 15 base-game charms to their maximum level.

guide.context: All charms need about 150,000 Favor and 135,000 Red Souls in total. Charms from the deluxe edition are not required.

steps.text: Find all 15 charms and fully upgrade each one.
Trade items for Favor at Yorimasa's Monument, and keep Red Souls for the upgrades.

achievements.description: Defeat 50 foes while in the Blazing State.
achievements.sortReason: Combat counter earned during normal play.
achievements.summary: Defeat 50 enemies while in Blazing State.

guide.context: Learn Blazing State first. The Blazing State Drill in the Practice Grounds gives one enemy per run.

steps.text: Parry attacks to fill the Blazing gauge until you enter Blazing State, then defeat enemies while it lasts.

achievements.sortReason: Combat counter earned during normal play.
achievements.summary: Perform 50 Reflex Combos.

guide.context: A Reflex Combo counts even if it does not kill. The Reflex Combos Drill in the Practice Grounds lets you farm it.

steps.text: Evade attacks to fill the Reflex Gauge. When it is full, Reflex Dodge an attack and choose the Reflex Combo.

achievements.sortReason: Combat counter earned during normal play.
achievements.summary: Defeat 100 enemies with Oni Armaments.

guide.context: The Wind-Whipper hits many enemies per use. Armament drills in the Practice Grounds also work.

steps.text: Fill the Oni Armament gauge and unleash any Oni Armament on groups of enemies.

achievements.description: Defeat 50 enemies in the Oni Awakened state.
achievements.sortReason: Combat counter earned during normal play.
achievements.summary: Defeat 50 enemies while in Oni Awakened state.

guide.context: The Oni Awakening Drill in the Practice Grounds lets you farm it.

steps.text: Activate Oni Awakening with L3 + R3 and defeat enemies, which are easy to counter with Issen in this state.

achievements.sortReason: Combat counter earned during normal play.
achievements.summary: Land 50 Issen attacks.

guide.context: The Issen Drill in the Practice Grounds lets you practice.

steps.text: Attack at the exact moment an enemy attack would hit you. You sidestep and strike.

achievements.description: Defeat 50 enemies with Chain Issen attacks.
achievements.sortReason: Combat counter earned during normal play.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemies using Chain Issen.

guide.context: A chain of 2 or more counts once. Pressing attack too early cancels the chain. The Chain Issen Drill in the Practice Grounds lets you farm it.

steps.text: Land an Issen, then press attack again while the bright light is on screen to target the next enemy.

achievements.sortReason: Combat counter earned during normal play.
achievements.summary: Assassinate 20 enemies.

guide.context: Running alerts enemies unless you learn Stealth While Running.

steps.text: Walk up behind an unaware enemy and press the prompt for a stealth kill.

achievements.sortReason: Combat counter earned during normal play.
achievements.summary: Deflect 50 projectiles back at enemies.

guide.context: Use the same timing as a parry.

steps.text: Learn the Deflect skill, then hold forward and press Guard when an arrow or magic shot reaches you.

achievements.sortReason: Combat counter earned during normal play.
achievements.summary: Score 100 headshots with your bow.

guide.context: Deflecting an arrow back at an archer drains its stamina and leaves it alive for a headshot.

steps.text: Aim slightly above an enemy's head and shoot. Archers and floating heads are easy targets.

achievements.description: Carry out 50 attacks with environmental objects.
achievements.sortReason: Combat counter earned during normal play.
achievements.summary: Hit enemies 50 times using objects from the environment.

guide.context: Each hit on an enemy counts. The enemy does not need to die.

steps.text: Throw kegs, flip or kick floor planks, drive carts into enemies, or shoot explosive barrels with your bow.

achievements.sortReason: Combat counter earned during normal play.
achievements.summary: Perform 50 Grab Reversals.

steps.text: When lightning surrounds an enemy's limb, evade toward the enemy to reverse its grab.

achievements.sortReason: Combat counter earned during normal play.
achievements.summary: Break an enemy's guard 50 times.

steps.text: Empty an enemy's stamina gauge before you kill the enemy.

achievements.description: Break 100 shields or pieces of enemy armor.
achievements.sortReason: Combat counter earned during normal play.
achievements.summary: Destroy 100 enemy shields or armor pieces.

guide.context: The Oni Strength Drill in the Practice Grounds lets you farm it.

steps.text: Use Oni Strength on shielded or armored enemies, such as Genma with block shields, Kogashira, and Hitotsume Sho.

achievements.description: Absorb 30 or more souls at once.
achievements.sortReason: Combat counter earned during normal play.
achievements.summary: Absorb at least 30 souls in a single absorb.

guide.context: Each orb counts, whatever its value, and orbs fade after a short time.

steps.text: Defeat about 6 enemies quickly so their orbs float together, then absorb them when the floating counter at the top reaches 30.

achievements.description: Defeat 3 enemies with continuous Break Issen attacks.
achievements.sortReason: Combat counter earned during normal play.
achievements.summary: Kill 3 enemies in one back-to-back Break Issen sequence.

guide.context: You can earn this in the tutorial, when a group of enemies ambushes you outside.

steps.text: Weaken 3 nearby enemies until each shows a red dot.
Issen the first, then press Light Attack to dash to the next, and again to the third.

achievements.description: Set three enemies ablaze at once.
achievements.sortReason: Combat counter earned during normal play.
achievements.summary: Set three enemies ablaze at once.

steps.text: Learn Firebird Flute: Charged Shot, charge the flute, and fire at the middle of 3 or more bunched enemies.
